items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of primary screening using a rotating drum screen;

The Facility is a membrane bioreactor (MBR) system... The treatment system consists of... a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration);
a concrete wet well for effluent storage prior to land discharge to the spray field.
Biosolids are collected in a 50-gallon plastic container and disposed off-site.
